recalled_knowledge.item: NREFT operator definitions O1-O15 and their leading nuclear responses (M, Sigma', Sigma'', Delta, Phi'') and q/v scalings
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2013 (JCAP 02, 004), Table 1; Anand et al. 2014

recalled_knowledge.item: Anand et al. isospin convention c^0 = (c_p + c_n)/2, c^1 = (c_p - c_n)/2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Anand, Fitzpatrick, Haxton, PRC 89 (2014) 065501, Eq. 21 region

recalled_knowledge.item: LZ 2024 WIMP search (220 live days, ROI 5.4-55 keV) saw no excess and its high-mass limit corresponds to roughly 3-5 signal events in the ROI
Leading-order NR reductions: L1, L5 -> O1; L2 -> O10; L3 -> O11; L4 -> O6; L15 -> O4; L19 -> 4 O4
Tensor-tensor magnetic Lagrangian L10 reduces to 4 (m_N^2/m_M^2)[(q^2/m_N^2) O4 - O6], whose squared amplitude is q^4 Sigma' (transverse spin only)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: hand derivation from sigma^{ij} q_j -> 2 (q x S)^i; consistent with Anand et al. 2014

recalled_knowledge.item: Sigma' form factor of 129Xe/131Xe has a node near 50-60 keV; M form factor minima near 100 and 265 keV
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: observed directly in the WimPyDD output and Fig. 1 (not recalled)
